_about: Flaky-test quarantine (docs/TEST_STRATEGY.md). Suites listed here are SKIPPED on every PR/push run so a flaky integration test cannot block a release, and run SEPARATELY every night (nightly-suite.yml, `npm test -- --only-quarantined`) so they are never forgotten. To quarantine a suite, add {"path": "tests/foo.test.js", "reason": "...", "added": "YYYY-MM-DD", "issue": "..."}. A quarantined suite that passes 5 nightly runs in a row should be moved back here into the normal run.
